t: These are numbers one to three Hyde Park Place, a group of houses in the City of Westminster. They were designed by George Ledwell Taylor, an architect and archaeologist who lived from 1788 to 1873. He was surveyor of buildings to the naval department, and he worked on the dockyards at Chatham, Woolwich and Sheerness. Later he laid out parts of the Bishop of London's estate, including Westbourne Terrace and Chester Place, which are not far from here.
